title: Add /hello endpoint to app.py with test
approach: Create `app.py` with a Flask application that exposes a `/hello` GET endpoint returning `{"message": "Hello, World!"}`. A new test file `tests/test_app.py` will be created to verify the endpoint's status code and JSON response using Flask's test client. The `requirements.txt` will be updated to include `Flask`.
tests_to_write: Verify that the GET /hello endpoint returns an HTTP 200 OK status.
Verify that the GET /hello endpoint returns the JSON body `{"message": "Hello, World!"}`.
edge_cases: Ensure Flask is correctly added to `requirements.txt` to avoid dependency errors.
Handle cases where the endpoint path might be misspelled or the response content is incorrect.
